cases.case: hoe, front already tilled: tills a side tile instead
seeds, front planted: plants the left neighbour
can, front watered: waters a side tile
seeds in hand, ripe crop at the side: harvests the side, does not plant the front
sprinkler, front holds a jar: placed on a side tile
hoe on open grass, hold 1 s: works a 3-wide strip, not a line

markerNote: Marker = 1 logical px corner brackets (about 0.3 mm on an iPhone 13). "free" (white) is drawn both when the action will work and when it will not but the tile is walkable; only blocked tiles get the faint "solid" style.
